title: bar

panels.title: Panels

x-settings.label: prefs.bar.panels
x-settings.keywords: panels layout bars edge style dock menubar taskbar rail corners statusline ribbon two bars multi monitor modules

panels.description: Bar panels (empty = the single bar from position/layout/screenList). Each item: {id, edge: top|bottom|left|right, style: classic|islands|menubar|statusline|ribbon|rail|corners|dock|floating|pills|dock-like|none, groups: {start, center, end, drawer, gapStart, gapEnd: [module ids]}, align: fill|center|start|end, size (module px, 0 = style), thickness (px, 0 = auto), margin (px, -1 = style), flat (bool), autohide: auto|always|never, reserve (bool), screens ([] = all; names, primary, secondary), enabled, options: {surface: bg|bar|none}}. See modules/bar/panels/PanelLayout.js.

moduleOptions.title: Module options
moduleOptions.description: Options of bar modules, shared by every panel showing them.

show.title: Show
show.description: Window title module: app name, window title or both.

showIcon.title: Show icon
showIcon.description: Window title module: show the app icon.

maxWidth.title: Max width
maxWidth.description: Window title module: widest the title may get.

showPinned.title: Show pinned
showPinned.description: Taskbar: show pinned apps that are not running.

showLabels.title: Show labels
showLabels.description: Taskbar (not in docks): show app names next to icons.

items.title: Items
items.description: System stats module: metrics shown, in order.

showDescription.title: Show description
showDescription.description: Weather module: show the condition text.

showWeather.title: Show weather
showWeather.description: Clock module: lead with the weather symbol (off: the day name, or nothing when the date is shown).

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: World clocks: [{label, zone}] with IANA zone names (e.g. Asia/Tokyo).

count.title: Count
count.description: Downloads stack: recent files fanned out.
